consequence.statement: The reported status code in gRPC request metrics now reflects the Grpc-Status header value instead of the HTTP response status code, which may change observed metrics and alert thresholds.

assertion.statement: In Traefik v3.0.0, the status code reported for gRPC requests in metrics changes from the HTTP response status code to the value of the Grpc-Status header.
